comments.text: Watching from Philippines Tue {7:40 am} Aug 25, 2026. I love watching documentaries like this.Discovering country by country different cultures, history and  other remote parts of the world.

replies.author: @PlanetVista4K
replies.text: So glad to hear you enjoy exploring different cultures and history with us from around the world!

replies.author: @PlanetVista4K
replies.text: You are very welcome, glad you enjoyed the look into the island's culture!

replies.author: @PlanetVista4K
replies.text: Håfa adai — and thank you, for both notes. Viewers actually on Guam are the ones we most hoped would find this one; if there's a corner of the island you felt was left out, say the word and it goes on the list.

comments.author: @TravelBeyond4K
comments.text: The rugged coastline and limestone cliffs of Northern Guam show a side of Micronesia that is far wilder than typical resort photos. Seeing those jungle-covered volcanic hills meet the outer coral reefs really highlights how isolated and pristine this island environment truly is.

replies.author: @PlanetVista4K
replies.text: That rugged northern landscape really defines the island's character far better than the tourist brochures ever could.

comments.author: @GeorgeMereb
comments.text: Hafa Adai and good afternoon from Guahan! It's here that the great U.S. of A's day begins as well.

replies.author: @TravelBeyond4K
replies.text: Hafa Adai! It must be amazing living in such a beautiful place where the day literally starts for the US. Thanks for sharing that local warmth!

replies.author: @PlanetVista4K
replies.text: Håfa Adai right back, and thank you for watching from Guåhan itself. You're right — while the rest of the States is still on yesterday, the day has already started with you. Si Yu'os ma'åse' for stopping by.

comments.author: @MJSavea
comments.text: Hafa Adai! Im a chamorro from the island of Saipan in the Northern Mariana Islands. Its about 100+ miles north of Guam. I lived on Guam for about 16 years but have relocated to Washington State. I would very much love to go back.

replies.author: @PlanetVista4K
replies.text: Håfa Adai! Sixteen years on Guam and roots in Saipan — that's a lot of the Marianas in one life. If the film missed something about home, we'd rather hear it from you than read it anywhere else.

comments.author: @AmazingDiscoveriesTopUS
comments.text: Would you actually live on Guam - thousands of miles from the US mainland but surroundede by this incredible Pacific beauty? YEs or NO?

replies.author: @PlanetVista4K
replies.text: That's a great question! Living thousands of miles from the US mainland, surrounded by such incredible Pacific beauty, definitely has its pros and cons. I'd have to weigh them carefully.
